pages.text: Lots of long loaves came out of the oven. They were longer than Coco was tall.
They had to go to the display shelf. "I'll carry them," said Coco.
Mr. Pig rolled up his sleeves. "You carry these all at once!"
He gathered an armful of long loaves. There were more than ten.
One loaf slipped. As he tried to catch it, two more slipped.
Tumble, tumble! The loaves fell back into the big basket.
He gathered another armful. Down they tumbled again.
Coco held one loaf in both arms, carefully, as if holding a baby.
One loaf down, then another. The long loaves filled the shelf one by one.
Every loaf was carried over, right down to the last one. Mr. Pig followed Coco with just one loaf, carefully, as if holding a baby.
